summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any tests or repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the formatter entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal, next to show_cursor and set_alt_screen. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for the title control. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased "Added" section with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_console.py (set_window_title on a forced terminal, assertion skipped when legacy_windows is set), test_control.py (Control.title segment and control list), test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, mocked wrapper, set_title called with "Hello, world!"). Nothing was committed. Known limitation per spec: title text is not sanitized, so BEL or ESC in a title can truncate or inject escape sequences.
